verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's docs explicitly cover creating flags, targeting rules, percentage rollouts, and environments—the core primitives needed to create and toggle a flag live in production—and community accounts confirm real-world use of rules-based targeting and rollout by percentage/attributes with minimal latency. However, missing for 10: a documented quickstart/time-to-first-flag walkthrough proving the 'minutes after signup' claim, and independent hands-on confirmation of onboarding speed (one community comment even calls the product generally 'a pain to use').
